title: Endpoint and doubled matching families on their finite union
statement: For a simplicial object V [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-object], an object T, and an integer n, let l,r:T to V_n and let p be a proper-face family for the ordered path object [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-ordinal-path; lem-weil-pbc-matching-object-proper-faces]. Suppose each face of p has endpoints equal to the corresponding restrictions of l and r. Then there is a compatible family on the union A_n inside Delta[2n+1] of the two endpoint n-simplices and all doubled proper faces, with values l,r and p at these generators. Every degree of A_n is nonempty.

source.place: Tag 01GN (lemma-add-simplices): the endpoint and proper-face finite inclusion

proof.text: Define A_n as the supremum of subcomplexes generated by both endpoint inclusions and the doubled injective proper faces. Constant simplices from the first endpoint make every degree nonempty. As a subcomplex of a standard simplex it is finite.

Pairwise agreement on equal endpoints follows by monicity; opposite endpoints have disjoint vertex ranges. For an endpoint and doubled proper face, the endpoint intersection factorization and the supplied endpoint equations give agreement after every operator.

For two doubled proper faces use their doubled common face from the intersection lemma. Its dimension is below n since it injects into a proper face. Naturality of p along the two projections identifies both restricted values. Apply the general generated-face gluing theorem.

theorem exists_family {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] (V : SimplicialObject C)
    (n : ℕ) (T : C) (l r : T ⟶ V.obj (op ⦋n⦌))
    (p : (Functor.const _).obj T ⟶ (ordinalPath V).properFaceDiagram n)
    (hl : ∀ a : ProperFaceCategory n,
      p.app (op a) ≫ V.map (left a.obj.left).op = l ≫ V.map a.obj.hom.op)
    (hr : ∀ a : ProperFaceCategory n,
      p.app (op a) ≫ V.map (right a.obj.left).op = r ≫ V.map a.obj.hom.op) :
    ∃ f : ∀ m : ℕ, (subcomplex.{w} n).toSSet.obj (op ⦋m⦌) →
        (T ⟶ V.obj (op ⦋m⦌)),
      (∀ (m k : ℕ) (φ : ⦋m⦌ ⟶ ⦋k⦌)
        (s : (subcomplex.{w} n).toSSet.obj (op ⦋k⦌)),
        f k s ≫ V.map φ.op = f m ((subcomplex n).toSSet.map φ.op s)) ∧
      (∀ i, f (degree n i) ⟨SSet.stdSimplex.objEquiv.symm (face n i),
        faceUnion_generator_mem (degree n) (face n) i⟩ =
        (match i with | .inl false => l | .inl true => r | .inr a => p.app (op a)))
